acceptanceCriteria: `cem status --format sarif` writes a SARIF 2.1.0 log that validates against the OASIS schema and GitHub's accepted subset.
Each unbound or over-policy hunk becomes one result with the hunk's path and line range and a stable rule id.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). No SARIF producer exists in the Go source. SARIF is the standard carrier for CI findings; GitHub code scanning renders uploaded SARIF as pull-request annotations (docs.github.com sarif-support-for-code-scanning). Mapping unbound hunks, stale evidence, unknowns over policy and mechanical exceptions to SARIF results at hunk locations puts the CEM in front of reviewers without a Corvint-specific review surface. Related: V1-0195 (hunk-anchored review projection).
title: cem: emit SARIF 2.1.0 for cem status findings so CI shows hunk-anchored annotations
